row.notes: Career_Populate_RnDPieSlices: mov rbx,[rsp+0x40], join after the department-name switch; rdi = name (default case error_department), r14d = department code, read by lng_rnd_dept_%s, the VM child hash, Vm_Holder_SetCStr and the icon path

verify.notes: V0109 mov rbx,[rsp+0x40] (5B) is the join of the code switch (4 jmps + fallthrough from engine); rdi = name, default case error_department, r14d = code, read by lng_rnd_dept_%s, the djb2 child hash, Vm_Holder_SetCStr and (normal path) the icon args; note the default case is only reachable if the DeptGuard skip at 0x141f4821c (code>3 -> next) is bypassed, and rdi is replaced by shutdown/regulation before the icon on those state paths
